title: Nimble Crisp Mexican Chicken Tacos
description: A low-calorie, festive Mexican dish featuring lime and boiled chicken, served in a mason jar with a buttery and crisp texture.
instructions: Boil the chicken in a large pot of water until it is cooked through.
Drain the chicken and shred it into small pieces.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the taco seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the shredded chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the taco seasoning.
Squeeze the lime juice over the chicken and stir to combine.
In a separate skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the corn tortillas to the skillet and cook until they are crispy and golden brown.
Assemble the tacos by placing a portion of the chicken onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, and shredded cheese.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve in a mason jar.
